resources.string: No collection on this device yet.
A collection arrives as an .obz file from the editor. Open it from your files, share it to this app, or fetch it below.
Without a collection this device has nothing to say.
“%1$s” is not newer than the stored copy and was not taken.
Every button has what it promised.
This collection works. Only whoever built it can change this — the order below is the order it appears on the board.
Nothing is missing from this collection.
Press and hold to leave the board
Four digits. It is what gets you back out of the board once the tablet is handed over, so pick something you will not have to think about.
This leaves the board and releases the tablet.
A picture is missing. The button shows its label only.
A picture is too large to show, so the button has none.
A picture could not be read, so the button has none.
A recording is missing. The button stays silent and is marked.
A recording could not be read. The button stays silent and is marked.
A recording is longer than 30 seconds. The button stays silent and is marked.
This button asks for something this viewer cannot do, so it is switched off.
The board has a gap where a button was meant to be.
A file inside the collection is named unusually. It was found anyway.
The collection disagrees with itself about where a file lives.
A picture also pointed somewhere online. The one in the collection was used.
A colour could not be read, so the standard one was used.
A PIN for the way out of the board
A PIN is set. Leaving the board asks for it.
No PIN set. The board can be left by holding the handle.
On. Home and Overview will not leave the board.
Off. Home and Overview still leave the board — that can only be changed in Android\'s settings, not here.
Enter the current PIN. After that the board can be left without one.
The collection is deleted from this device — every board, picture and recording in it. The file it came from is untouched.
